info.description: A RESTful API for managing tasks with JWT authentication and user task assignment

post.description: Creates a new comment on a task. User must own the task or have assigned it.

delete.description: Deletes a comment by its ID. Only the comment author can delete it.

get.description: Retrieves a specific comment by its ID

put.description: Updates an existing comment. Only the comment author can update it.
